new.name: OKDOC AI
new.description: OKDOC AI is a smart e-signature tool for quotes and contracts: you upload a document or generate one from a prompt, send it for signature, and see who opened it, how long they read and where they stalled, with WhatsApp alerts and automatic reminders. It can collect payment once the client signs, and it is free to start.

new.name: Fluxtail
new.description: Fluxtail is centralized log management you drive from your AI tools: its hosted MCP server lets Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI or VS Code with Copilot search logs, investigate errors and manage streams, receivers and sources, and a browser Live Tail shows logs as they arrive. Plans start at $19 a month, with a 14-day trial and no card required.

new.name: VibeListing
new.description: VibeListing is an AI Shopify app that turns raw product photos, supplier URLs or product ideas into ready-to-sell listings, with virtual try-on product images, SEO titles and optimized descriptions you preview and then publish to your store. A free plan is available, and paid plans start at $29 a month.

new.name: CloudGPU Compute
new.description: CloudGPU Compute lets AI agents rent GPUs through a REST API and an MCP server: an agent can browse the public GPU catalog, get a quote, receive its own key through an owner-approved connect link, and run jobs or instances with server-enforced spending and time limits. Results must be exported and validated before the instance is destroyed, and GPUs are billed by the minute.

new.name: Halloween AI
new.description: Halloween AI turns a selfie or pet photo into a Halloween costume portrait in a minute or two, painting the costume, makeup and a spooky background around your own face, with around 30 looks including pet costumes. Your first portrait is free; one-time credit packs start at $5.99 and failed runs are refunded.

new.name: SearchByVideo
new.description: SearchByVideo searches inside your own videos with AI: you describe a moment, an object or on-screen text and it returns the matching scenes with timestamps ranked by confidence, including on silent footage, so you can jump straight to them. You can try a live sample free; Pro costs $24.99 a month or $99.99 a year.

new.name: Two Mountains
new.description: Two Mountains is an AI reflection companion for overthinking and sleepless nights: you write the thought that keeps returning and receive a personal letter that answers it from two angles, Laozi's Taoism and Marcus Aurelius's Stoicism. The first three letters are free; Companion costs $9.80 a month or $79 a year, and a one-time 7-Day Reset is $19.

new.name: Vistella
new.description: Vistella is an AI image generation and editing platform: you describe an idea or upload an image and create portraits, product visuals, artwork, illustrations or architecture with a choice of publicly listed third-party models, online or through one developer API. Pricing is usage-based, with credit packs from $5 that do not expire.

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Turns websites into clean, LLM-ready data for agents.
